svg.desc: The megabeast loop. A bite session claims the plan, builds one bite through subagents, and relays. A review session reviews the bite and relays. A handle session answers every review thread and relays to the next bite session. After eight sessions in a chain, the operator pastes the relay command by hand to start a new chain.
